title: anisotome geniculata
intro: Anisotome geniculata, commonly known as the New Zealand button fern, is a plant species native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, and therapeutic actions such as wound healing and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents present in Anisotome geniculata include essential oils, flavonoids, and polyphenols, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic potential.
